artifacts.summary: Confirms the seed report's measured breakage line-for-line against the live books-observe.sh/test-books-observe.sh, extracts the consuming repo's exact lint-validated-by.sh discovery grammar (with a correction: the pointer arrow is Unicode U+2192, not ASCII '->', and the fault-frame dash is U+2014 em dash), resolves all six anchor citations to concrete docs/book-convention/NN-slug.md targets, corrects the seed's known-gap-register census claim (2/15/1 is already accurate; only the SHA/date are stale), confirms books/tool/book-snapshot.sh does not exist in the consuming repo (expected, not a defect), and recommends manifest.json placement for the convention_version/measured_at_commit pin.

memory_candidates.content: When a task description renders a Unicode pointer/separator character (e.g. a reduced-marker '-> full exercise history' pointer or a '--' heading dash) in ASCII form, verify the literal bytes in the actual source file before writing any regex against it -- the consuming repo in this case used U+2192 (->) and U+2014 (em dash), not their ASCII look-alikes, and the reference lint script (lint-validated-by.sh) already encodes the Unicode form correctly.

check-extension-docs.sh imposes no top-level-key schema restriction on an extension's manifest.json -- its checks walk specific known keys (provides.*, routing_agents*, observers) and never reject an unrecognized sibling key. A new structured pin/version field can be added safely to any extension's manifest.json without tripping the gate.
